fusions.name: Kicked-Up Clods
fusions.desc: Looses 3 clods from the turned soil at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Harrow's Weight
fusions.desc: Drags the tines through the target with your full weight behind them, dealing 28 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Up the Rows
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds, with +5% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Fallow Breath
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
